cancellation_semantics: Check non-nil context during document preflight and freezing, before and after every provider call and source hash, throughout CPU raster, between atomic opacity/dissolve/composite stages and before publication. Any failure returns a zero Result and no partial Surface.
capability_semantics: This v1 Compile consumes a complete visual-only Document v2 and advertises only explicitly enabled video, image and cutly.vector.path-viewport-px.v2 source kinds plus the exact visual properties, keyframes, interpolation, dissolve and optional linear-video-retime semantics implemented here. Non-zero vector dissolves additionally advertise the scoped cutly.transition-scope.vector-path-viewport-px.v1 capability. Enabled text, audio, legacy vector v1 and rendering extensions fail capability negotiation; they are never advertised or silently ignored.
clip_semantics: Apply evaluator crop and transform through cutly.raster.cpu-affine-bilinear-linear-rgba16.v1 to either native or intrinsic vector surface, then evaluator opacity through the CPU kernel. Provider surfaces remain immutable and are never modified.
composition_semantics: Process evaluator layers strictly in background-to-foreground track-array order and source-over each completed target layer. Native/vector interleaving, provider completion order and map iteration cannot change z-order.
dispatch_semantics: Freeze the canonical Document v2 asset, timeline, track, clip and transition indexes. For every evaluator ClipEvaluation, TrackKindVideo with AssetKindVideo/Image dispatches only to the native provider; TrackKindVector with AssetKindVector/path-viewport-px.v2 dispatches only to the expression provider. No provider chooses its own scope or z-order.
excluded_responsibilities: Mixed A/V documents are outside this v1 because evaluator capability negotiation currently gates the complete document; a future visual-scope preflight must preserve the original DocumentHash while ignoring only non-visual requirements. Media resource authorization/decode trust, VFR/PTS/rotation/SAR/YUV/HDR rules, vector strokes/curves, text shaping, audio, masks, output color conversion, encoding, muxing, persistence, scheduling, signatures and publication also remain outside this compositor.
failure_semantics: Unsupported capability, wrong provider route, scope/index/kind/profile/hash/time/geometry/receipt mismatch, unavailable required provider, overflow, cancellation or kernel failure fails closed. There is no provider fallback, lower-quality vector path, partial source set or success with a missing layer.
gap_semantics: A timeline time with no active supported visual layer returns one complete transparent target Surface and an explicit empty source array.
ownership_semantics: Compile deep-freezes canonical document-derived dispatch state. Programs support arbitrary seek order and concurrent immutable reads. Provider surfaces are borrowed only for validation/rasterization, target surfaces own their pixels, capabilities are defensive copies and serializable receipts contain no mutable provider storage.
receipt_semantics: Result sources are ordered by evaluator layer and outgoing-before-incoming transition role. Each has a strict outer clip-versus-transition evaluation union with both JSON keys present; a transition branch carries transition ID/index/profile/role plus its exact ClipBinding, so visible handles cannot masquerade as ordinary clips. The provider receipt is a second native-versus-expression union, and expression receipts use a third visible-request-versus-transition-request union. Every linked scope/time agrees exactly. Strict live validation checks runtime self-consistency by requiring Surface and recomputing its final canonical pixel hash; it does not prove source-pixel causality. Serialized structural validation treats PixelHash as an unauthenticated claim. Offline provenance requires trusted provider replay, an artifact chain or trusted-execution signature.
resource_semantics: Bound document graph/canonical bytes and tracks before compile; bound active layers/source requests, every provider surface, target/raster dimensions, exact geometry bits and the fixed six-target-frame working peak. Full target layers are processed incrementally; receipts scale only to MaxSourceRequests.
source_validation: Native responses must echo the complete rastercompositor request and match frozen content hash, allowlisted profiles, geometry and independently recomputed surface hash. Expression responses must echo the complete visible or transition-handle request and match frozen semantic source hash, viewport, profile chain, raster receipt counts/geometry and independently recomputed surface hash. Provider claims never replace these checks.
transition_semantics: For an active dissolve, render outgoing then incoming evaluator handles with their exact actual times and properties. Native media uses its native request. Vector expressions use the additive transition-handle v2 provider contract with exact transition ID/index/profile and role; visible-time clamping is forbidden. Dissolve with the evaluator's exact complementary weights.
